title: 1996 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement:
The letters \(P,\) \(Q,\) \(R,\) \(S,\) and \(T\) represent numbers located on the number line as shown.

Which of the following expressions represents a negative number?

solutions.text:
From the number line, \(P\) and \(Q\) are negative and \(R,\) \(S,\) and \(T\) are positive.

Then \(P \cdot Q\) is positive; \(\dfrac{S}{Q} \cdot P\) has two negative factors, so it is positive; \(\dfrac{R}{P \cdot Q}\) is positive; and \(\dfrac{S + T}{R}\) is positive. Since \(P\) is to the left of \(Q,\) \(P - Q\) is negative.

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: From the number line, \(P\) and \(Q\) are negative while \(R,\) \(S,\) and \(T\) are positive
A product or quotient is negative only with an odd number of negative factors; check each choice
